numberingPolicy.summary: Use simple linear numbering for a concise seven-minute overview deck.

Add new slides only when they replace an existing idea or materially improve the story.

narrativeSpine: Mentorship is valuable, but access to the right mentor is still too dependent on chance, visibility, and manual coordination.
Mentor Match turns mentor discovery and pairing into a lightweight workflow with clearer inputs, better fit, and easier first contact.
The first milestone is a narrow pilot that proves demand, match quality, and operational repeatability before the concept scales.

slides.title: The Access Problem
slides.purpose: Show why a mentorship product is needed before explaining how Mentor Match works.

slides.subheader: People often find mentors through luck, visibility, or whoever has time, not through a process designed for fit.
slides.takeaway: The current matching experience is uneven, manual, and easy to miss.

slides.title: Why It Matters
